purpose: ONE corpus, read by BOTH scout implementations, pinning the never-file-twice contract rung by rung. tools/idea_scout.py and internal/ideascout implement the same four-rung dedup contract; before this file they were tied together by prose alone (docs/idea-scout.md, 'Two implementations, one contract'), which is why the SAME defect had to be fixed twice: cfe66c656 (Python, #5543) then 00f270957d2a (Go, #5544). Every case below is asserted by internal/ideascout/ideascout_test.go AND by tools/idea_scout_test.py, so a rung that changes in one implementation and not the other reds a test instead of aging into a re-filed issue (#5547).

rung_notes.seen-cache: node-local .idea-scout/seen.json fast path; git-ignored, may be lost, never the guarantee
rung_notes.filed-stamp: the DURABLE rung: the <!-- idea-scout-source: ... --> stamp read back out of the scout's own label-targeted filing history. A source filed once is never filed again.
rung_notes.issue-body: best-effort: the candidate URL appears verbatim in some issue body inside the RECENCY WINDOW
rung_notes.title-near: best-effort: Jaccard token overlap >= dup_jaccard with an issue title inside the RECENCY WINDOW

rung_order: seen-cache, then filed-stamp, then issue-body, then title-near. The order is load-bearing: filed-stamp must be reported ahead of issue-body so a windowed guess is never mistaken for the guarantee in the run report.
index_build_rule: stamped = stamp_index(scout_issues) UNION stamp_index(window_issues); (title_sets, bodies_joined) = existing_issue_index(window_issues). The union is deliberate: a filed issue whose label a human stripped is still ours and its stamp is still proof we filed that source. The window contributes NOTHING to the durable rung beyond that union.

window_only_cases_rule: stamped = stamp_index(window_issues) ONLY (no scout index) and seen = {}. This is exactly the state the tracker was in when #5543 happened: the git-ignored cache was lost on a node and the filing had aged out of the 800-issue window. Every case here MUST come back new - that is what proves the dedup_cases above are not passing for some other reason.

run_rule: Each run case is replayed end to end through the real entry point (Run for Go, main() for Python) with every network/gh boundary stubbed. window_issues is the tracker newest-first and the stub TRUNCATES it to thresholds.issue_scan_limit - a recency window. scout_issues answers the label-targeted query and is returned whole however old. A non-empty window_error / scout_error makes that fetch fail.
